annotations.title: Check ZBS sending window, quota and promotion limits

description: Check whether a ZBS template send is allowed: the sending window by tag in Vietnam time (Tag 1 round the clock, Tag 2 and 3 07:00-22:00; for Tag 1 at night a warning notes the -133 wording; the conflicting announcement dates are named), the OA daily quota (levels 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, unlimited; default 20000), Tag 3 limits per user (1 per day, 30 per month), and the quota upgrade conditions (Good quality over 7 days and 2 x the daily quota sent in 7 days). Reference only, nothing is sent. Examples: {"tag":3,"send_time":"21:30","daily_volume":15000}; {"tag":2,"send_time":"06:30"}; {"tag":3,"promo_sent_to_user_today":1}; {"tag":1,"quota_level":20000,"sent_last_7_days":45000}.

daily_volume.description: Template messages the OA plans to send that day (all templates).

delivery.description: How messages are addressed: "phone" (phone number, default) or "uid" (Zalo user ID for this OA; cheaper, not for OTP, quick response, journey or carousel).

promo_sent_to_user_this_month.description: Tag 3 messages this OA has already sent to the same user this month (before this one).

promo_sent_to_user_today.description: Tag 3 messages this OA has already sent to the same user today (before this one).

quota_level.description: OA daily quota level for template messages: 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, unlimited (default 20000, where a new OA starts; 1000 and 5000 are penalty levels).

send_time.description: Planned send time, HH:MM in Vietnam time (UTC+7).

sent_last_7_days.description: Messages sent successfully in the last 7 days (to check the quota upgrade volume condition).

tag.description: Template tag: 1 transaction, 2 customer care, 3 promotion.
